title: Construction Cost Estimation from Plans

blueprintSignals.name: Gross area and storeys
blueprintSignals.definition: gross floor area and number of storeys read from the plans
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Plans differ on what counts as gross, so define it

blueprintSignals.name: Spec level
blueprintSignals.definition: classifier score from finish schedules and notes for low, medium, high and luxury
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Specifications are text and often incomplete

blueprintSignals.name: Region index
blueprintSignals.definition: construction cost index of the project region relative to a base
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Indices lag, so update them often

blueprintSignals.name: Similar project cost
blueprintSignals.definition: cost per square metre of the five most similar past projects, escalated to today
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Matching is subjective, so show the projects used

label: For "Construction Cost Estimation from Plans": Estimate construction cost early from drawings, specifications and past projects, with quantity take-off support. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: The final cost in the data includes changes, so it is not the cost of the plan as drawn.
